allowed_outcomes: CE+ViM generalizes reasonably and remains the primary system.
ArcFace shows external improvement despite internal instability, but remains exploratory because confirmation was mixed.
Both systems degrade substantially externally, indicating domain shift is a dominant limitation.
External results vary strongly by morphology, making morphology-dependent reliability the principal finding.
article_decision_rules.arcface_rule: Delivery 6 failed internal confirmation; ArcFace cannot be upgraded to confirmed proposed method from a single favorable external aggregate.
article_decision_rules.vim_primary_question: Does CE+ViM remain the strongest stable external system across seeds and splits?
article_decision_rules.vietoris_rips_role: explanatory embedding-topology analysis only; never a classifier, anomaly score, fusion feature, or thresholding method

external_dataset.independence_rule: Primary external dataset must be independent from MLL23 and must not be selected or rejected based on model performance.
external_dataset.license_stop_condition: Stop if official license or terms prohibit the intended research use.
external_dataset.primary_preference: Use AML-Cytomorphology_LMU only if official metadata supports a defensible morphology mapping to exact known and out-of-taxonomy labels.
selection_criteria: single-cell images or reliably isolated individual cells
prefer exact mature known WBC labels plus additional immature or abnormal morphology labels

forbidden_changes: change CE or ArcFace training recipes
fit PCA/scalers/prototypes/kNN banks on external data
perform stain tuning using external labels
drop difficult external classes because of poor performance
use Vietoris-Rips features for classification or OSR

locked_delivery6_conclusion.summary: ArcFace improved known-class Fisher geometry but did not produce stable OSR gains across V1/V2 seeds.

osr_policy.threshold_policy: Frozen threshold from corresponding MLL23 known_validation using the already predeclared known-acceptance rule.
osr_policy.vim_fit_rule: ViM is fit or reconstructed using only the original corresponding MLL23 known_train embeddings/logits for each frozen run; never fit on external features.

external_primary: deterministic resize/crop to 224x224 matching training pipeline
forbidden: preprocessing tuned against external labels or metrics

forbidden_mappings: blast to lymphocyte unless the source explicitly defines equivalence
taxonomy.rule: Only exact, officially documented morphology equivalences can be mapped to canonical known classes; ambiguous labels are excluded from the primary analysis before evaluation.

betti_curves.epsilon_grid: fixed, identical grid for comparable normalized cosine diagrams

clouds.optional_unknowns: all other MLL23 unknowns only as one predeclared secondary set

construction.library_preference: GUDHI RipsComplex if practical; record library/version/algorithm and do not change backend between representations
construction.normalization: L2 normalize every embedding before distance computation

diagram_distances.secondary: p-Wasserstein distance with fixed p=2 if computationally tractable

feasibility_smoke.selection_source: known-train or fixed non-test development clouds only

vietoris_rips.fixed_sampling: Select sample IDs once per dataset/class with VR_SAMPLE_SEED=2026 and reuse the exact same IDs across CE, ArcFace, and all model seeds when samples exist.
vietoris_rips.mll23_v1_v2_known_rule: Use intersection of eligible V1 and V2 known-test sample IDs for known-class VR comparisons.
summaries: H1 bars above fixed relative persistence threshold
